nodes.name: Commits In (Webhook)
nodes.notes: Entry point of the pipe. Anything that has repository observations POSTs them here: the collector workflow, the backfill replay of cached JSON files, or you with curl. Unauthenticated by design for now — the stack binds 127.0.0.1 only. Before this is exposed on a network it needs header auth, because anything that can reach this URL can write rows.

nodes.name: Validate Payload
nodes.notes: Checks the shape before any SQL runs: a record must have repository_id and full_name, and commits must be an array if present. Fails loudly with the offending repository rather than half-writing a batch. Then base64-encodes the JSON, because the Postgres node splits query parameters on commas and commit messages contain them.

parameters.query:
-- Persist one batch of repository observations. Atomic: one statement, one transaction.
-- $1 = base64(utf8(json)) of {"repositories":[ record, ... ]}
-- Idempotent: running the same payload twice changes nothing except last_seen/refreshed.
with payload as (
  select convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb as j
),
repos as (
  select r as rec, (r ->> 'repository_id')::bigint as rid
  from payload, jsonb_array_elements(j -> 'repositories') as r
),
upserted as (
  insert into mnemora_repositories (
    repository_id, full_name, visibility, default_branch, description, is_fork,
    is_archived, html_url, pushed_at_utc, languages_bytes, history, commit_count,
    source_state, source_error, data_changed_at_utc, refreshed_at_utc)
  select
    rid,
    rec ->> 'full_name',
    coalesce(rec ->> 'visibility', 'public'),
    rec ->> 'default_branch',
    rec ->> 'description',
    coalesce((rec ->> 'is_fork')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((rec ->> 'is_archived')::boolean, false),
    rec ->> 'html_url',
    nullif(rec ->> 'pushed_at_utc', '')::timestamptz,
    coalesce(rec -> 'languages_bytes', '{}'::jsonb),
    rec ->> 'history',
    coalesce((rec ->> 'commit_count')::integer, 0),
    rec ->> 'source_state',
    rec ->> 'source_error',
    coalesce(nullif(rec ->> 'data_changed_at_utc', '')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(nullif(rec ->> 'refreshed_at_utc', '')::timestamptz, now())
  from repos
  on conflict (repository_id) do update set
    full_name = excluded.full_name,
    visibility = excluded.visibility,
    default_branch = excluded.default_branch,
    description = excluded.description,
    is_fork = excluded.is_fork,
    is_archived = excluded.is_archived,
    html_url = excluded.html_url,
    pushed_at_utc = excluded.pushed_at_utc,
    languages_bytes = excluded.languages_bytes,
    history = excluded.history,
    commit_count = excluded.commit_count,
    source_state = excluded.source_state,
    source_error = excluded.source_error,
    data_changed_at_utc = case
      when mnemora_repositories.pushed_at_utc is distinct from excluded.pushed_at_utc
        or mnemora_repositories.commit_count is distinct from excluded.commit_count
      then now()
      else mnemora_repositories.data_changed_at_utc end,
    refreshed_at_utc = excluded.refreshed_at_utc
  returning repository_id
),
incoming as (
  select r.rid, r.rec ->> 'full_name' as full_name, c as commit
  from repos r, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(r.rec -> 'commits', '[]'::jsonb)) as c
  where c ->> 'sha' is not null
),
pruned as (
  delete from mnemora_commits mc
  using (select distinct rid from repos) p
  where mc.repository_id = p.rid
    and not exists (
      select 1 from incoming i
      where i.rid = mc.repository_id and i.commit ->> 'sha' = mc.sha)
  returning mc.sha
),
saved as (
  insert into mnemora_commits (
    sha, repository_id, full_name, authored_at_utc, committed_at_utc, message,
    author_login, author_name)
  select
    commit ->> 'sha', rid, full_name,
    nullif(commit ->> 'authored_at_utc', '')::timestamptz,
    nullif(commit ->> 'committed_at_utc', '')::timestamptz,
    commit ->> 'message',
    commit -> 'author' ->> 'login',
    commit -> 'author' ->> 'name'
  from incoming
  on conflict (sha) do update set
    last_seen_at_utc = now(),
    full_name = excluded.full_name,
    message = excluded.message,
    author_login = excluded.author_login,
    author_name = excluded.author_name
  returning (xmax = 0) as is_new
)
select
  (select count(*) from upserted)           as repositories,
  (select count(*) from pruned)             as commits_pruned,
  (select count(*) from saved)              as commits_seen,
  (select count(*) from saved where is_new) as commits_new;

nodes.name: Save Batch
nodes.notes: The only writer to the product database. One statement, one transaction: upsert repositories, delete commits for those repositories that this payload did not contain (pruning), then upsert the commits it did contain. All three happen together or not at all, so a failed run cannot leave a repository with its commits deleted and none reinserted.

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.notes: Returns the counts so the caller can verify what happened instead of assuming: repositories upserted, commits pruned, commits seen, commits new. The backfill uses these numbers to check itself.
